So, the main issue was that the initial attempt to download the dataset used an incorrect URL, resulting in the wrong file type. This led to a parsing error and the realization that the URL was invalid. The mistake was made in Step 1 by the StatisticalAnalysis_Expert, who didn't confirm the correct URL before downloading. This mistake caused the subsequent steps to fail because the dataset was incorrect.
